Works without any of it, too. ## Features - **Card** — `<>`: thumbnail, name, type, pages, size, open and download. [rimir/drop-attach](https://github.com/rimir-cc/tw-drop-attach) puts one into the tiddler you drop a file on. - **Full view** — the body of every binary tiddler: **Pages** (strip + large page), **Sheets** (workbook order), **Original** (images, PDFs), **Text** (extracted text, marked when cut off). Only the tabs that have something show. - **Embedded or external** — base64 tiddlers and `_canonical_uri` files look the same; a file that is not on this machine shows *not available here* instead of a broken image. - **Open / download** — from either form, also for large embedded files. - **Generated tiddlers out of the way** — hidden in search and Recent, a note on each one says where it comes from; never edited. ## Prerequisites - TiddlyWiki 5.4.0 or later - Optional: TW Desk (makes the derivatives), [rimir/drop-attach](https://github.com/rimir-cc/tw-drop-attach) (drop files onto tiddlers), [rimir/doc-template](https://github.com/rimir-cc/tw-doc-template) (branded docs) ## Quick Start 1. Install the plugin and reload. 2. Open any image or PDF tiddler: its body is the full view. 3. Put `<>` into a tiddler for a card. ## License MIT — see [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md). Pieces |!Tiddler |!Role | |`engine` |Global functions and procedures: the lookups (`derived-view.thumb` / `pages` / `sheets` / `text-tid`), labels (`family`, `icon`, `label`, `meta`, sizes), the scope (`applies`), `derived-view.keep` for lists, the image with its fallback, the actions, and the `derived-view` procedure itself | |`card` / `full` |The two views; both expect `<>` (set by `derived-view`) | |`body` + `$:/config/ViewTemplateBodyFilters/rimir-derived-view` |Body cascade entry (before `default`): tiddlers in the scope get the full view as their body | |`derived-note` |ViewTemplate segment above the body of a generated tiddler: where it comes from | |`core/search-results`, `core/recent` |Overrides of `$:/core/ui/DefaultSearchResultList` and `$:/core/ui/SideBar/Recent`: the same as the core, plus `filter` | |`file.js` |Library: where the file comes from (`sourceOf`), the file name to save as, base64 → Blob | |`open.js` |`<$action-derived-view-open>`: opens or saves the file | |`families` |JSON: icon and label per kind of file | !! Matching derivatives Only by fields, as the TW Desk interface asks: `tw-desk-derived` (`thumb`, `page`, `sheet`, `text`) and `derived-from` = the original's title. Titles are never parsed. Sheets follow the original's `sheet-names` (each name is looked up by the sheet tiddler's `sheet` field); sheets not in that list follow, by name. The page count shown is `page-count` when present (TW Desk caps the page images at 50, the count stays complete). !! Missing files `$image` puts `tc-image-error` on an image that fails to load; the stylesheet hides it and shows the `dv-unavailable` note right after it. No JS, no probing. PDFs (shown in an iframe by the core) cannot be detected this way. !! Open and download Browsers refuse a `data:` URI as a page, and a data URI of a large file in an attribute is slow. So `open.js` builds a blob URL only on click (and frees it after a minute); an externalized file is opened by its `_canonical_uri`, relative to the wiki's URL. !! Why overrides for search and Recent Both lists are core shadows with their filters inline. The overrides keep the core text and add one filter step, `filter`, which keeps a tiddler unless it has `tw-desk-derived` and the setting `hide-derived` is not `no`. Plugin shadows win over the core's (core priority 0). Q: I see no thumbnails or pages. They come from TW Desk, which makes them while the wiki is stopped. Restart the wiki after adding the file, and check that derivatives are enabled for the wiki in TW Desk. Without them you get the type icon (or the image itself). !! Q: A thumbnail says "not available here". The tiddler points at a file (`_canonical_uri`) that is not on this machine, e.g. `files/` is not in your git clone. The tiddler itself is fine. !! Q: A PDF shows only some of its pages. TW Desk makes page images for the first 50 pages (configurable there). The full view says so; ''Original'' shows the whole PDF. !! Q: Can I edit a generated tiddler? Don't: TW Desk replaces it when it regenerates. Put your own fields on the original. !! Q: The search no longer finds `…/page/3`. Generated tiddlers are hidden in search and Recent. Switch it off in the settings (`hide-derived`). "},"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/doc/overview":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/doc/overview","created":"20261104200000000","modified":"20261104200000000","rdt.hub-category":"tools","rdt.hub-category-name":"Tools","rdt.hub-order":"5","rdt.order":"1","rdt.plugin-key":"derived-view","rdt.plugin-name":"derived view","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Binary tiddlers with their thumbnails, pages, sheets and text","rdt.section":"Overview","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page"> <$fill $name="body"> !! What it does Shows binary tiddlers (images, PDFs, office files, …) the way you want to look at them, including what TW Desk derives from them: a thumbnail, one image per page, slide or sheet, and the extracted text. Everything derived is optional: without it you still get a clean card with type, size, open and download. !! Two views * ''Card'' — `<>`: thumbnail (TW Desk's, else the image itself, else a type icon), name, a line like //PDF · 12 pages · external file//, and ''open'' / ''download''. rimir/drop-attach appends one of these to the tiddler you drop a file on. * ''Full view'' — the body of every binary tiddler (and `<>`): tabs for whatever exists — ''Pages'' (a strip of page images, the chosen page large), ''Sheets'' (one per sheet, in workbook order), ''Original'' (images and PDFs, as TiddlyWiki renders them), ''Text'' (extracted text, with a note when it was cut off). !! Both ways of storing a file A binary tiddler holds its file either embedded (base64 in `text`) or externalized (`text` empty, `_canonical_uri: files/`). Both show the same; ''open'' and ''download'' use the `_canonical_uri` when there is one, otherwise the embedded data. When a file is not on this machine (e.g. `files/` not in the git clone), images show a quiet //not available here// instead of a broken picture. !! Generated tiddlers stay out of the way TW Desk's derivatives are ordinary tiddlers. They are hidden in search and Recent (setting), and when you open one anyway a note says where it comes from. derived-view never changes them. Procedures |!Call |!Shows | |`<>` |Card of the binary tiddler `Title` (default: the current tiddler) | |`<>` |Full view, as in the tiddler's body | |`<$action-derived-view-open $tiddler="Title"/>` |Action: open the file in a new tab; `$download="yes"` saves it | A missing title shows //attachment … is missing//. !! Functions All take the original's title and select from all tiddlers: call them at the start of a filter run, e.g. `[function[derived-view.pages],]`. |!Function |!Result | |`derived-view.thumb(t)` |TW Desk's thumbnail tiddler | |`derived-view.pages(t)` |Page tiddlers by `page` | |`derived-view.sheets(t)` |Sheet tiddlers in `sheet-names` order, then the rest | |`derived-view.text-tid(t)` |The extracted-text tiddler | |`derived-view.family(t)` |`image` `pdf` `doc` `sheet` `slides` `audio` `video` `archive` `file`, from `type` | |`derived-view.meta(t)` |The card's line: label · pages · sheets · size · external file | |`derived-view.applies(t)` |`t` when it is in the scope (gets the full view as body) | `derived-view.keep` is a filter for lists: `[…filter]` drops generated tiddlers (unless switched off). !! Configuration |!Tiddler |!Default |!Meaning | |`$:/config/rimir/derived-view/scope` |`[is[binary]!is[system]!has[tw-desk-derived]]` |Tiddlers whose body is the full view | |`$:/config/rimir/derived-view/hide-derived` |`yes` |`no` shows TW Desk's generated tiddlers in search and Recent again | !! State |!Tiddler |!Holds | |`$:/state/rimir/derived-view/tab/` |Chosen tab of the full view | |`$:/state/rimir/derived-view/page/<title>` |Chosen page tiddler | |`$:/state/rimir/derived-view/sheet/<title>` |Chosen sheet tiddler | !! What TW Desk writes (interface draft v1) |!Field |!On |!Meaning | |`tw-desk-derived` |derivative |`thumb`, `page`, `sheet`, `text` | |`derived-from` |derivative |Title of the original | |`page` / `sheet` |page / sheet |Page number / sheet name | |`page-count` |original |Pages or slides in total | |`sheet-names` |original |Sheet names in workbook order (title list) | |`text-truncated` |original |`yes` when the extracted text hit TW Desk's size cap | </$fill> </$transclude> "},"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/documentation":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/documentation","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$list filter="[[$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template]plugin-type[plugin]]" variable="ignore"> {{$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/doc/overview||$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/doc-viewer}} </$list> <$list filter="[[$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template]plugin-type[plugin]!match[plugin]]" variable="ignore"> <div class="rr-settings-info-card"> ''doc-template'' plugin is not installed. See the <<tag readme>> tab for documentation. </div> </$list> "},"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/engine":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/engine","tags":"$:/tags/Global","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"\whitespace trim <!-- Lookups for the derivative tiddlers TW Desk writes for a binary tiddler (interface draft v1): matched on the fields tw-desk-derived (thumb, page, sheet, text) and derived-from (the original's title), never on titles. Every derivative is optional. The functions select from all tiddlers, so call them at the start of a filter run. --> \function derived-view.thumb(t) [derived-from<t>tw-desk-derived[thumb]first[]] \function derived-view.pages(t) [derived-from<t>tw-desk-derived[page]nsort[page]] <!-- sheets in workbook order (the original's sheet-names), then any others --> \function derived-view.sheets(t) [<t>get[sheet-names]enlist-input[]] :map[all[tiddlers]derived-from<t>tw-desk-derived[sheet]field:sheet<currentTiddler>first[]] +[!is[blank]] =[derived-from<t>tw-desk-derived[sheet]sort[sheet]] +[unique[]] \function derived-view.text-tid(t) [derived-from<t>tw-desk-derived[text]first[]] \function derived-view.applies(t) [<t>subfilter{$:/config/rimir/derived-view/scope}] <!-- what kind of file: image pdf doc sheet slides audio video archive file --> \function derived-view.family(t) [<t>get[type]prefix[image/]then[image]] ~[<t>get[type]match[application/pdf]then[pdf]] ~[<t>get[type]prefix[audio/]then[audio]] ~[<t>get[type]prefix[video/]then[video]] ~[<t>get[type]search:title:regexp[sheet|excel]then[sheet]] ~[<t>get[type]search:title:regexp[presentation|powerpoint]then[slides]] ~[<t>get[type]search:title:regexp[word|opendocument\.text|rtf]then[doc]] ~[<t>get[type]search:title:regexp[zip|7z|rar|tar|gzip]then[archive]] ~[[file]] \function derived-view.icon(t) [function[derived-view.family],<t>] :map[[$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/families]get[text]jsonget<currentTiddler>,[icon]] \function derived-view.label(t) [function[derived-view.family],<t>] :map[[$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/families]get[text]jsonget<currentTiddler>,[label]] \function derived-view.name(t) [<t>get[caption]] ~[<t>] <!-- "12 pages" / "1 page" for the number coming in; page-count may exceed the page images (TW Desk caps them) --> \function derived-view.plural(one, many) [<currentTiddler>match[1]then<one>addprefix[1 ]] ~[<currentTiddler>addsuffix[ ]addsuffix<many>] \function derived-view.page-total(t) [<t>get[page-count]] ~[function[derived-view.pages],<t>count[]] \function derived-view.pages-label(t) [function[derived-view.page-total],<t>!match[0]] :map[function[derived-view.plural],[page],[pages]] \function derived-view.sheets-label(t) [function[derived-view.sheets],<t>count[]!match[0]] :map[function[derived-view.plural],[sheet],[sheets]] <!-- size of an embedded file: base64 holds 3 bytes per 4 characters, without the = padding; external files have no text --> \function derived-view.bytes(t) [<t>!has[_canonical_uri]get[text]trim:suffix[=]length[]multiply[0.75]floor[]] \function derived-view.size-label(t) [function[derived-view.bytes],<t>compare:number:gteq[1048576]divide[1048576]fixed[1]addsuffix[ MB]] ~[function[derived-view.bytes],<t>compare:number:gteq[1024]divide[1024]fixed[0]addsuffix[ KB]] ~[function[derived-view.bytes],<t>fixed[0]addsuffix[ bytes]] \function derived-view.meta(t) [function[derived-view.label],<t>] [function[derived-view.pages-label],<t>] [function[derived-view.sheets-label],<t>] [function[derived-view.size-label],<t>] [<t>has[_canonical_uri]then[external file]] +[join[ · ]] <!-- filter for lists that should not show generated tiddlers (the search and Recent overrides use it as filter<derived-view.keep>) --> \procedure derived-view.keep() [<currentTiddler>!has[tw-desk-derived]] ~[{$:/config/rimir/derived-view/hide-derived}match[no]] <!-- An image (thumbnail, page, original) with a quiet note instead of a broken picture when its file is not on this machine ($image sets tc-image-error) --> \procedure derived-view.image(source, class) <span class={{{ [[dv-img]] [<class>] +[join[ ]] }}}><$image source=<<source>> loading="lazy"/><span class="dv-unavailable">not available here</span></span> \end \procedure derived-view.actions(tiddler) <span class="dv-actions"> <$button class="tc-btn-invisible dv-action" tooltip="Open the file in a new tab"><$action-derived-view-open $tiddler=<<tiddler>>/>open</$button> <$button class="tc-btn-invisible dv-action" tooltip="Save the file"><$action-derived-view-open $tiddler=<<tiddler>> $download="yes"/>download</$button> </span> \end <!-- <<derived-view "Title">> — a card (thumbnail, name, type, pages, size, open/download); mode="full": the full viewer (pages, sheets, original, text). Without a title: the current tiddler. --> \procedure derived-view(tiddler, mode:"card") <$let dv-tid={{{ [<tiddler>!is[blank]] ~[<currentTiddler>] }}}> <%if [<dv-tid>is[missing]] %> <span class="dv-missing">attachment <$link to=<<dv-tid>>/> is missing</span> <%elseif [<mode>match[full]] %> <$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/full"/> <%else%> <$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/card"/> <%endif%> </$let> \end "},"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/families":{"text":"{ "image": {"icon": "🖼", "label": "Image"}, "pdf": {"icon": "📄", "label": "PDF"}, "doc": {"icon": "📝", "label": "Document"}, "sheet": {"icon": "📊", "label": "Spreadsheet"}, "slides": {"icon": "📽", "label": "Presentation"}, "audio": {"icon": "🎵", "label": "Audio"}, "video": {"icon": "🎬", "label": "Video"}, "archive": {"icon": "🗜", "label": "Archive"}, "file": {"icon": "📎", "label": "File"} } ","type":"application/json","title":"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/families"},"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/file.js":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/file.js","text":"/*\ title: $:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/file.js type: application/javascript module-type: library Where a binary tiddler's file comes from and what it is called when saved. Externalized tiddlers (empty text, _canonical_uri) point at their file; embedded ones hold it as base64 in the text. \*/ "use strict"; // {url} for an externalized file, {base64, type} for an embedded one, null otherwise exports.sourceOf = function(fields) { if(!fields) { return null; } if(fields._canonical_uri) { return {url: fields._canonical_uri}; } var info = $tw.config.contentTypeInfo[fields.type]; return fields.text && info && info.encoding === "base64" ? {base64: fields.text, type: fields.type} : null; }; // The file name to save as: the last part of the title, with the type's // extension added when it has none exports.fileName = function(fields) { var name = String(fields.title).split("/").pop() || "file", info = $tw.config.contentTypeInfo[fields.type], ext = info && info.extension; return ext && !/\.[^.]+$/.test(name) ? name + ext : name; }; exports.toBlob = function(base64, type) { var bytes = atob(base64.replace(/\s+/g, "")), array = new Uint8Array(bytes.length); for(var i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) { array[i] = bytes.charCodeAt(i); } return new Blob([array], {type: type}); }; ","type":"application/javascript","module-type":"library"},"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/full":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/full","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"\whitespace trim <!-- Full view of the binary tiddler <<dv-tid>> (its body, or <<derived-view … mode:"full">>). Tabs only for what exists: Pages (TW Desk page images), Sheets (one image per sheet), Original (images and PDFs, rendered by the core), Text (extracted text). Images open with Original, everything else with its pages or sheets. An externalized file is opened by its _canonical_uri; an embedded one through a blob URL made on click (browsers refuse data: URIs as pages, and a large data URI is slow). \*/ "use strict"; var Widget = require("$:/core/modules/widgets/widget.js").widget; var file = require("$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/file.js"); var REVOKE_AFTER = 60 * 1000; var OpenWidget = function(parseTreeNode, options) { this.initialise(parseTreeNode, options); }; OpenWidget.prototype = Object.create(Widget.prototype); OpenWidget.prototype.render = function(parent, nextSibling) { this.computeAttributes(); this.execute(); }; OpenWidget.prototype.execute = function() { this.actionTiddler = this.getAttribute("$tiddler", this.getVariable("currentTiddler")); this.actionDownload = this.getAttribute("$download", "no") === "yes"; }; OpenWidget.prototype.refresh = function(changedTiddlers) { var changedAttributes = this.computeAttributes(); if(changedAttributes["$tiddler"] || changedAttributes["$download"]) { this.refreshSelf(); return true; } return this.refreshChildren(changedTiddlers); }; OpenWidget.prototype.invokeAction = function(triggeringWidget, event) { var tiddler = this.wiki.getTiddler(this.actionTiddler), source = tiddler && file.sourceOf(tiddler.fields); if(!source || !$tw.browser) { return true; } var url = source.url, blobUrl = null; if(!url) { blobUrl = url = URL.createObjectURL(file.toBlob(source.base64, source.type)); } if(this.actionDownload) { var a = this.document.createElement("a"); a.href = url; a.download = file.fileName(tiddler.fields); this.document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); this.document.body.removeChild(a); } else { window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener"); } if(blobUrl) { setTimeout(function() { URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl); }, REVOKE_AFTER); } return true; }; exports["action-derived-view-open"] = OpenWidget; ","type":"application/javascript","module-type":"widget"},"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/readme":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/readme","text":"! Derived view Shows binary tiddlers — images, PDFs, office files — with what TW Desk derives from them: thumbnail, page and sheet images, extracted text. Works without any of it, too. !! Features * ''Card'' — `<<derived-view "Title">>`: thumbnail, name, type, pages, size, open and download. rimir/drop-attach puts one into the tiddler you drop a file on. * ''Full view'' — the body of every binary tiddler: ''Pages'' (strip + large page), ''Sheets'' (workbook order), ''Original'' (images, PDFs), ''Text'' (extracted text, marked when cut off). Only the tabs that have something show. * ''Embedded or external'' — base64 tiddlers and `_canonical_uri` files look the same; a file that is not on this machine shows //not available here// instead of a broken image. * ''Open / download'' — from either form, also for large embedded files. * ''Generated tiddlers out of the way'' — hidden in search and Recent, a note on each one says where it comes from; never edited. !! Prerequisites * TiddlyWiki 5.4.0 or later * Optional: TW Desk (makes the derivatives), `rimir/drop-attach` (drop files onto tiddlers), `rimir/doc-template` (branded docs) !! Quick Start # Install the plugin and reload. # Open any image or PDF tiddler: its body is the full view. # Put `<<derived-view "Some/file.pdf">>` into a tiddler for a card. "},"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/settings":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/settings","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"\whitespace trim !! max-width: 100%; } .dv-img img.tc-image-error { display: none; } .dv-unavailable { display: none; font-size: 0.85em; color: <<colour muted-foreground>>; font-style: italic; } .dv-img img.tc-image-error + .dv-unavailable { display: inline-block; } .dv-meta { font-size: 0.85em; color: <<colour muted-foreground>>; } .dv-actions { display: inline-flex; gap: 10px; font-size: 0.85em; } .dv-action { color: <<colour primary>>; } .dv-action:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .dv-note, .dv-missing { font-size: 0.85em; color: <<colour muted-foreground>>; font-style: italic; margin: 6px 0; } /* card */ .dv-card { display: inline-flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; max-width: 100%; width: 72px; height: 72px; overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; } .dv-card-thumb .dv-img img { max-width: 72px; max-height: 72px; object-fit: contain; } .dv-type-icon { font-size: 36px; line-height: 1; } .dv-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; } .dv-card-name { font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } /* full view */ .dv-full-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .dv-head-icon { font-size: 1.4em; } .dv-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid <<colour tiddler-border>>; margin-bottom: 8px; } .dv-tab { background: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-bottom: none; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0; padding: 3px 10px; cursor: pointer; color: <<colour foreground>>; } .dv-tab-on { border-color: <<colour tiddler-border>>; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; background: none; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .dv-strip-item .dv-img img { height: 90px; width: auto; max-width: none; } .dv-strip-on { border-color: <<colour primary>>; } .dv-strip-label { font-size: 0.75em; color: <<colour muted-foreground>>; max-width: 120px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; margin-bottom: 8px; border-left: 3px solid <<colour muted-foreground>>; background: <<colour tiddler-info-background>>; } "},"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/test/test-derived.js":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/test/test-derived.js","text":"/*\ title: $:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/test/test-derived.js type: application/javascript tags: [[$:/tags/test-spec]] Tests for derived-view: finding TW Desk's derivatives by their fields, the labels, the scope, hiding generated tiddlers, and where a file comes from. \*/ "use strict"; var file = require("$:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/file.js"); var P = "dvtest/"; function render(text) { return $tw.wiki.renderText("text/plain", "text/vnd.tiddlywiki", "\\import $:/plugins/rimir/derived-view/engine\n" + text); } function list(filter) { return render("<$text text={{{ " + filter + " +[format:titlelist[]join[ ]] }}}/>"); } function derived(kind, from, title, extra) { $tw.wiki.addTiddler($tw.utils.extend({title: title, "tw-desk-derived": kind, "derived-from": from, type: kind === "text" ? "text/plain" : "image/jpeg", "_canonical_uri": "files/.derived/x.jpg"}, extra || {})); } describe("derived-view", function() { var REPORT = P + "report.pdf", BOOK = P + "budget.xlsx"; beforeEach(function() { $tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: REPORT, type: "application/pdf", text: "", "_canonical_uri": "files/report.pdf", "page-count": "120"}); // titles deliberately do not follow the <title>/<kind> pattern: only fields count derived("thumb", REPORT, P + "t1"); derived("page", REPORT, P + "p10", {page: "10"}); derived("page", REPORT, P + "p2", {page: "2"}); derived("page", REPORT, P + "p1", {page: "1"}); derived("text", REPORT, P + "txt", {text: "hello"}); $tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: BOOK, type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", text: "UEsDBA==", "sheet-names": "Summary [[Q 1]]"}); derived("sheet", BOOK, P + "s-q1", {sheet: "Q 1"}); derived("sheet", BOOK, P + "s-extra", {sheet: "Archive"}); derived("sheet", BOOK, P + "s-sum", {sheet: "Summary"}); }); afterEach(function() { $tw.wiki.filterTiddlers("[prefix[" + P + "]] [prefix[$:/config/rimir/derived-view/]]").forEach(function(title) { $tw.wiki.deleteTiddler(title); }); }); describe("derivatives", function() { it("finds thumbnail, pages in page order and text by their fields", function() { expect(list("[function[derived-view.thumb],[" + REPORT + "]]")).toBe(P + "t1"); expect(list("[function[derived-view.pages],[" + REPORT + "]]")).toBe(P + "p1 " + P + "p2 " + P + "p10"); expect(list("[function[derived-view.text-tid],[" + REPORT + "]]")).toBe(P + "txt"); }); it("orders sheets by sheet-names and keeps sheets missing from it at the end", function() { expect(list("[function[derived-view.sheets],[" + BOOK + "]]")).toBe(P + "s-sum " + P + "s-q1 " + P + "s-extra"); }); it("finds nothing for a file without derivatives", function() { $tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: P + "a.png", type: "image/png", text: "iVBO"}); expect(list("[function[derived-view.thumb],[" + P + "a.png]] [function[derived-view.pages],[" + P + "a.png]]")).toBe(""); }); }); describe("labels", function() { it("names the kind of file from its type", function() { $tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: P + "d", type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"}); $tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: P + "s", type: "application/vnd.ms-powerpoint"}); $tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: P + "z", type: "application/zip"}); $tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: P + "o", type: "application/octet-stream"}); expect(list("[function[derived-view.family],[" + REPORT + "]] [function[derived-view.family],[" + BOOK + "]]")).toBe("pdf sheet"); expect(list("[function[derived-view.family],[" + P + "d]] [function[derived-view.family],[" + P + "s]] [function[derived-view.family],[" + P + "z]] [function[derived-view.family],[" + P + "o]]")).toBe("doc slides archive file"); }); it("counts all pages from page-count, sheets from the sheet tiddlers", function() { expect(render("<$text text={{{ [function[derived-view.meta],[" + REPORT + "]] }}}/>")).toBe("PDF · 120 pages · external file"); expect(render("<$text text={{{ [function[derived-view.meta],[" + BOOK + "]] }}}/>")).toBe("Spreadsheet · 3 sheets · 4 bytes"); }); it("says 1 page and sizes embedded files in KB and MB", function() { $tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: P + "one.pdf", type: "application/pdf", text: new Array(4097).join("A"), "page-count": "1"}); expect(render("<$text text={{{ [function[derived-view.meta],[" + P + "one.pdf]] }}}/>")).toBe("PDF · 1 page · 3 KB"); }); }); describe("scope and lists", function() { it("shows binary, non-system, non-generated tiddlers with the full view", function() { $tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: "$:/" + P + "logo.png", type: "image/png", text: "iVBO"}); $tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: P + "note", text: "x"}); expect(list("[function[derived-view.applies],[" + REPORT + "]] [function[derived-view.applies],[" + BOOK + "]]")).toBe(REPORT + " " + BOOK); expect(list("[function[derived-view.applies],[" + P + "t1]] [function[derived-view.applies],[$:/" + P + "logo.png]] [function[derived-view.applies],[" + P + "note]]")).toBe(""); }); it("keeps generated tiddlers out of lists unless switched off", function() { var filter = "[prefix[" + P + "]filter<derived-view.keep>sort[]]"; expect(list(filter)).toBe(P + "budget.xlsx " + P + "report.pdf"); $tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: "$:/config/rimir/derived-view/hide-derived", text: "no"}); expect(list(filter + " +[count[]]")).toBe("10"); }); it("hides them in search and Recent", function() { var search = $tw.wiki.getTiddler("$:/core/ui/DefaultSearchResultList").fields; expect(search["first-search-filter"]).toContain("filter<derived-view.keep>"); expect(search["second-search-filter"]).toContain("filter<derived-view.keep>"); expect($tw.wiki.getTiddlerText("$:/core/ui/SideBar/Recent")).toContain('subfilter="filter<derived-view.keep>"'); }); }); describe("the file", function() { it("comes from _canonical_uri when externalized, else from the base64 text", function() { expect(file.sourceOf($tw.wiki.getTiddler(REPORT).fields)).toEqual({url: "files/report.pdf"}); expect(file.sourceOf($tw.wiki.getTiddler(BOOK).fields)).toEqual({base64: "UEsDBA==", type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"}); expect(file.sourceOf({title: "x", type: "text/vnd.tiddlywiki", text: "hi"})).toBe(null); }); it("is saved under the last part of the title, with an extension", function() { expect(file.fileName({title: "Kickoff/agenda.pdf", type: "application/pdf"})).toBe("agenda.pdf"); expect(file.fileName({title: "pasted", type: "image/png"})).toBe("pasted.png"); }); }); }); ","type":"application/javascript","tags":"[[$:/tags/test-spec]]"}}}
